description: Android activity class (HomeActivity) that displays a list of matches using RecyclerView, manages UI interactions, and navigates to a details screen upon item selection.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity displaying a list of matches; handles user interaction and navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up RecyclerView, and launches coroutine to collect match data.

methods.name: onMatchClicked
methods.description: Handles click events on match items, opening the details activity with selected match ID.
